name: Ansari Mohd Ayan Nasiruddin
bio: I build backends that have to be right about money. Most of what I know came out of one project: PrintOK, a print-on-demand platform where a customer pays from their phone and a shop's existing PC does the printing.

That project is where the interesting decisions live — keeping payment state and print state apart so nobody gets charged twice, storing prices as integer paise, freezing a rate card onto a job the moment it's quoted. Everything else on this desktop is either the toolkit that made it possible or practice work from before it.
now: 3rd semester BSc IT at AIKTC. President of Rise Club. Currently getting PrintOK in front of its first real shop.
